method: Manual CSV exports from the WHO ICTRP Search Portal. The site does not call registry APIs or scrape the portal.

queries.triage: Candidate records still require the initial precision sample.

queries.expression: "low level laser therapy" OR "low level light therapy" OR LLLT OR "laser phototherapy"
queries.triage: Candidate records still require the initial precision sample; inspect laser surgery and photodynamic therapy matches.

queries.purpose: Broader light-device terminology to assess recall
queries.expression: "red light therapy" OR "near infrared light" OR "LED therapy"
queries.triage: Route all records to manual review unless the record itself clearly describes therapeutic PBM.

include: Clinical intervention using non-thermal red or near-infrared light, including low-level laser or LED therapy, consistent with photobiomodulation.
exclude_or_review: Photodynamic therapy where the intended effect depends on a photosensitizer
Ablative, cutting, coagulation, surgical or other high-power thermal laser procedures
Diagnostic or imaging use of light
Records where the title or intervention is too vague to establish therapeutic PBM
notes: Do not search red light, infrared, laser, or LED as standalone terms.
WHO ICTRP search applies automatic synonyms; keep query-result rows whose mapped export text has no matching PBM phrase in manual review.
Keep the three query exports separate in the raw directory so recall and false-positive patterns can be audited.
The portal groups some records for the same trial; preserve registry identifiers and deduplicate only on explicit identifiers or portal grouping fields, never on title similarity alone.
